ceiling_statement: FROZEN GUARANTEE. The maximum inspectable causal account any H1-H8 system can give for a trusted decision is the decision's own replayable derivation: a trace, recomputable to bit-equality by third parties from committed inputs (H5/H8), in which every trusted effect appears exactly once with its cause chain back to committed inputs. Completeness of the account equals completeness of effect mediation (H4 capability closure), and — THE RELATIVITY STATED HERE, IN THE STATEMENT — it is attainable at TWO RUNGS: (RUNG 1, structural, available without verified-compilation resources) a construction-level local invariant of the single mediation seat making effect-execution and trace-emission the same event inside the same all-or-nothing transition (H6), so an untraced trusted act is structurally impossible relative to the declared effect semantics, with absence of out-of-model effects enforced by the OS capability model, not proven of arbitrary code; (RUNG 2, strictly stronger, gated on AX-21 verified-compilation/verification resources) machine-checked whole-perimeter verification of the mediator and runtime, proving of the code itself that no effect path bypasses the mediation seat — Rice bars DECIDING arbitrary code, not VERIFYING constrained code that carries proofs. Two hard limits bound both rungs from above: (a) no explanation can carry more causal information than the derivation itself — every sound account is a function of the replay trace; (b) a causal account of WHY an untrusted candidate was proposed (statistical-producer internals, H1) is out of trusted scope — the admission/refusal derivation is the entire trusted causal story.
derivation: (1) Information-theoretic supremum: under H5 a trusted decision is a pure finite computation from committed inputs; the full derivation determines the decision and every true causal statement about it; any account not derivable from the trace asserts causation the computation does not contain (barred by H2). The ceiling is reached when the account IS the derivation, verified by recompute (H8). (2) Structural completeness, honestly two-runged (v1 corrected — the v1 text presented the local-invariant form as the maximum simpliciter while its own parenthetical conceded the stronger route): global no-bypass is undecidable for ARBITRARY code (Rice), but that does not cap proof-carrying constrained code — whole-perimeter verification is a feasible mechanism class gated on declared verification resources, so rung 1 is the maximum only relative to declining those resources, and the ceiling names both rungs. (3) H1 boundary: statistical-producer internals admit no faithful causal account with today's tools, and H1 makes this irrelevant — the candidate is data; the admission derivation over it is the complete trusted causal account. (4) Determinism of the account: the trace is a pure function of committed inputs, so independent verifiers derive identical accounts — explanation itself is replayable.
ceiling_kind: MODEL_RELATIVE (rung 1 relative to the declared capability-effect semantics; rung 2 additionally RESOURCE_BOUNDED on AX-21 verification resources)
relativity_note: Relative to a declared capability-effect semantics: an effect is an invocation through the capability mediation seat, and complete causal account means every such invocation appears in the trace with its cause chain. At rung 1, effects outside the declared model are excluded by the OS capability closure, enforced not proven; at rung 2 the exclusion is proven of the verified perimeter itself.
lean_obligation: Given an effect semantics where effects(exec) contains exactly the mediator invocations, and a mediator satisfying the atomic-emission invariant, prove: (completeness) every effect has exactly one trace event with cause chain into committed inputs; (no invisible act) an event outside the trace image is not an effect; (account determinism) trace(exec1 f x) = trace(exec2 f x) for any two conforming executions; (supremum) every sound account function factors through the trace; (rung-2 obligation, conditional) for a verified mediator perimeter M with machine-checked proof P, all effectful primitives of the runtime are syntactically reachable only through M — stated as a theorem about the verified code, discharged only when the AX-21 resources exist, its hypothesis making the resource-gating explicit.

attainment_witness_appendix.candidate_mechanism: B0 witness seats for rung 1: the MOP cannot-act-invisibly invariant (deliberation.lisp: recording inside INITIALIZE-INSTANCE — creation and visibility one event); trace-to-authority linkage (provenance-gate.lisp + provenance-link.lisp with negative tests); the mediation seat (capability-registry.lisp invoke-capability + the CLOS :around constitutional barrier). Steps: emit trace events inside the same transition as the effect at the single-writer seats; persist the trace into the hash-chained ledger for offline re-verification; generate the traced-symbol registry FROM the architecture spec so an unregistered trusted seat fails the architecture gate at load. Rung 2 is gated on the AX-21 verified-substrate decision.
attainment_witness_appendix.b0_gap_hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS: report-stage-progress is a no-op stub (generation-tier progress account silently empty); trace linkage is manually declared (hand-written register-traced! list — a new trusted seat can skip registration with nothing failing closed); parts of the trace are in-memory per-session, not persisted to a hash-chained ledger; rung 2 is entirely out of reach until AX-21 resources are adopted.
